h1: Custom 18 oz Magnets for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 18 oz magnets in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for promotions, giveaways, and branding. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Custom 18 oz magnets offer a practical and durable promotional item that sticks around. Unlike lighter magnets, the 18 oz weight provides a sturdy hold for memos, photos, and documents on metal surfaces. Ideal for trade shows, office giveaways, or real estate marketing, these magnets can be printed with your logo and contact info. Choose from various shapes and sizes to match your brand perfectly.
heroAltText: Custom 18 oz magnets with full-color logo printing for promotional giveaways
